See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Get all fonts in the brand font library for the authenticated account.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `brands:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/get_brand_fonts_beta.json)

AgentHints.description: Optional hints emitted by the API for agent callers

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up actions for agents to take after this response

id.description: The ID of the brand button.

is_primary.description: Whether this button is the account's primary brand button. Only one button per account can be primary at a time — promoting another button automatically demotes the previous primary.

border.description: Border styles (color, width, style, active flag).

spacing.description: Spacing styles (padding on each side, in pixels).

preview_page_hex.description: Optional hex color for the preview-page background.

font_type.description: The kind of font to add.

family.description: The font family name. For web-safe fonts, one of: Arial, Arial Black, Century Gothic, Comic Sans MS, Courier, Courier New, Georgia, Geneva, Helvetica, Lucida, Lucida Grande, Lucida Sans, MS Serif, New York, Palatino, Palatino Linotype, Tahoma, Times New Roman, Trebuchet MS, Verdana.

name.description: Human-readable name for this font. Defaults to the family name.

variants.description: The Google font variants to add. Required for Google fonts.

fallback.description: The web-safe font used while a Google font loads or where it is unsupported. Defaults to `helvetica`.

id.description: The ID of the brand font.

name.description: Human-readable name for this font. Cannot be null.

variants.description: The Google font variants, replacing the current ones. Google fonts only; cannot be null or empty.

fallback.description: The web-safe fallback font. Google fonts only; cannot be null.

id.description: The ID of the brand font.

font_family.description: The CSS font-family value to set as `font_family` in brand text styles to use this font.

fallback.description: The web-safe font used while this font loads or where it is unsupported. Null for web-safe fonts.

variants.description: The weights and styles available for this font. Null for fonts without individually selectable variants.

id.description: The ID of the brand form defaults (must equal the account ID).

heading_text.description: Heading text styles. Send `null` to clear.

body_text.description: Body text styles. Send `null` to clear.

input.description: Patch the input field styles (per-field merge). Send `null` to clear.

background_color.description: Hex color for the form background. Send `null` to clear.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius of the form, in pixels. Send `null` to clear.

Klaviyo-API-Key.name: Authorization
Klaviyo-API-Key.description:
Private key authentication for /api/ endpoints is performed by setting the `Authorization` header to `Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key`
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15.pre/reference/api-overview#authentication
